title: OpenEPCIS extension (permissive): usfsma
description: Permissive capture schema for the https://ref.openepcis.io/extensions/us/fsma204/ extension. Declares known terms as optional and allows additional properties, so events that declare GS1-Extensions usfsma=https://ref.openepcis.io/extensions/us/fsma204/ validate and capture. Generated from the module ontology plus its JSON-LD context; tighten per ontology for field-level validation.

foodTraceabilityListCategory.x-access-level-rationale: The FTL category only restates that the product falls under a category of the FDA's publicly published Food Traceability List, revealing scope of the rule rather than any traceability record content (which goes to FDA on request per 21 CFR 1.1455(b)).
